problem_statement.en: Prefix caching in production engines such as vLLM and SGLang reuses KV entries only under exact prefix matches, so recurring 'spans' (documents, code files, tool descriptions) in RAG and agentic workloads miss the cache whenever they appear at different offsets. Existing Position-Independent Caching (PIC) implementations either require substantial engine changes (SPNL's CIDRA repositioning, MEPIC) or keep KV state outside the server (EPIC, CacheBlend), incurring host-to-device transfer overhead. The root conflict: shared KV blocks that store RoPE-rotated keys cannot serve the same span at two different offsets concurrently.
problem_statement.zh: vLLM 與 SGLang 等生產級引擎的 prefix caching 僅在前綴完全相符時重用 KV entry，因此 RAG 與 agentic 工作負載中反覆出現的 'span'（文件、程式碼檔案、工具描述）一旦出現在不同 offset 便會 cache miss。既有 Position-Independent Caching (PIC) 實作或需大幅修改引擎（SPNL 的 CIDRA repositioning、MEPIC），或將 KV 狀態存放於伺服器之外（EPIC、CacheBlend）而引入 host-to-device 傳輸開銷。根本衝突在於：共享 KV block 儲存經 RoPE 旋轉的 key，同一 span 無法同時以兩個不同 offset 服務並行請求。

key_innovation.en: A minimal PIC substrate built from two ingredients: (1) a positional-encoding-free KV cache that stores unrotated K vectors and applies RoPE to K tiles inside the Triton attention kernel using per-request logical positions, so one physical block serves concurrent requests at different offsets without copy/reposition; (2) three user-facing token-level primitives — block-aligned Padding, SSep (detaches a block from its preceding hash chain), and PDep (forces the block hash to depend on the entire preceding prompt) — that modify only vLLM's block-hashing behavior. With 78 LOC of core changes (61 new functionality) plus a modular attention backend, the primitives express Block-Attention, EPIC, and Prompt Cache within one running vLLM instance and compose natively with vLLM's CPU offload; a PIC-aware interleaved scheduling policy (ISPS) removes span-prefill/final-prompt synchronization barriers.
key_innovation.zh: 由兩個要素構成的極簡 PIC 基底：(1) positional-encoding-free KV cache——儲存未旋轉的 K 向量，於 Triton attention kernel 內依 per-request 邏輯位置對 K tile 套用 RoPE，使同一物理 block 可服務不同 offset 的並行請求而無需 copy/reposition；(2) 三個 user-facing 的 token-level primitive——block-aligned Padding、SSep（將 block 與其前置 hash chain 分離）與 PDep（強制 block hash 相依於完整前置 prompt）——僅修改 vLLM 的 block-hashing 行為。核心改動僅 78 LOC（其中 61 LOC 為新功能）加上模組化 attention backend，即可在同一 vLLM instance 中表達 Block-Attention、EPIC 與 Prompt Cache，並與 vLLM 原生 CPU offload 自然相容；另提出 PIC-aware 交錯排程策略（ISPS），消除 span-prefill 與 final-prompt 間的同步 barrier。

key_improvements.en: On 12,576 2WikiMultihopQA samples, MiniPIC with ISPS reaches 48.01 samples/s prefill throughput — 49% over baseline vLLM (32.21) and 33% over SPNL/CIDRA (36.14); eliminating the barrier adds ~9% over batched PIC (44.07). Cached-span TTFT drops by up to two orders of magnitude vs vanilla vLLM; worst-case (PIC-disabled) overhead of RoPE-in-kernel is only 5.7%.
key_improvements.zh: 於 12,576 筆 2WikiMultihopQA 樣本上，MiniPIC 搭配 ISPS 達到 48.01 samples/s 的 prefill 吞吐量——較 baseline vLLM (32.21) 提升 49%，較 SPNL/CIDRA (36.14) 提升 33%；消除 barrier 較 batched PIC (44.07) 再提升約 9%。cached-span TTFT 相較 vanilla vLLM 最多降低兩個數量級；RoPE-in-kernel 的最壞情況（停用 PIC）開銷僅 5.7%。

scope_assumptions.en: Targets RoPE-based transformers only (ALiBi/NoPE require different handling). Marker-placement correctness is the user's responsibility — incorrect padding or markers can cause false cache hits (validation intentionally kept outside the engine). Span techniques approximate full causal attention and reduce accuracy; evaluation uses Tulu3-block-ft, a Llama-3-8B variant fine-tuned for span-style RAG attention. vLLM's eviction policy is unchanged, so a cached span is not guaranteed to remain in GPU memory until its dependent prompt is scheduled. Single H100, prefill-only throughput; SPNL baseline runs on vLLM 0.10.2 vs MiniPIC's 0.15.01 (version bias assessed as negligible).
scope_assumptions.zh: 僅針對 RoPE-based transformer（ALiBi/NoPE 需不同處理）。marker 放置的正確性由使用者負責——錯誤的 padding 或 marker 位置可能造成 false cache hit（驗證刻意留在引擎之外）。span 技術為完整 causal attention 的近似，會降低準確率；評估採用 Tulu3-block-ft，即針對 span 式 RAG attention 微調的 Llama-3-8B 變體。vLLM 的 eviction policy 未修改，cached span 不保證在其相依 prompt 被排程前仍留在 GPU 記憶體中。實驗為單張 H100、僅量測 prefill 吞吐量；SPNL baseline 建於 vLLM 0.10.2 而 MiniPIC 為 0.15.01（版本差異經評估影響甚微）。
